Article.ArticleTitle: Synthetic cohort report on SYNTHA loss-of-function variants (SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE)

Abstract.AbstractText: SYNTHA has been associated with synthetic disorder A in earlier reports.

🧬 In 12 individuals with synthetic disorder A and SYNTHA loss-of-function variants, synthetic seizure was observed in all individuals and synthetic hypotonia in 7 individuals. Synthetic ataxia was not observed in this cohort.
We plan to assess synthetic developmental delay in a follow-up study.

Article.ArticleTitle: Synthetic phenotype note on SYNTHB loss-of-function variants (SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE)

Abstract.AbstractText: Among 9 individuals with synthetic disorder B and SYNTHB loss-of-function variants, synthetic seizure and synthetic ataxia were reported.
Whether synthetic hypotonia occurs in synthetic disorder B remains inconclusive.
